served_mismatch: For the requested longest trial-reported follow-up, the registry reports overall-study HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.72 to 0.87), up to 1869 days. The served HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.82) correctly describes the publication's earlier interventional trial-end analysis at median 2.0 years, but not the longest follow-up held in this packet.

candidate_rejections.span: During a median of 2.0 years follow-up, a primary outcome event occurred in 432 of 3304 patients (13.1%) in the empagliflozin group and in 558 of 3305 patients (16.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001)
candidate_rejections.why: Valid primary composite result at interventional trial end; rejected only for the longest-follow-up interpretation of the requested timepoint.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults meeting CKD entry criteria fall within the question; the selected analysis includes all randomized participants.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Adults with a race-adjusted CKD-EPI 16 eGFR of at least 20 but less than 45 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 of body-surface area (irrespective of level of albuminuria);

notes: Interpreted 'trial end / longest trial-reported follow-up' as longest follow-up held. Registry spans are accepted because only the registry supplies the overall-study estimate including post-trial follow-up. If the intended timepoint is exclusively randomized treatment-period end, the served publication estimate is correct. The registry's overall-study endpoint description omits ESKD and uses a decline of more than 40%, whereas the publication includes ESKD and a decline of at least 40%; these definitions should not be silently equated.
